changes: Replaced Vec<Vec<PackedBlock>> with one pointer table owning native-layout PackedMapNode chains; no shadow block payloads or owner registry
Global Box node ownership retains stable addresses during rehash and transfers the bucket allocation during move
Real node methods now implement insertion/removal/contains/copy/hash and real findNext/findPrev implement iteration and extrema
Borrowed iterator follows native node links with native exhausted-key cache; detached numeric cursor validates current nodes against the live graph
Clear/drop free every node exactly once, then free the separately allocated pointer table; move assignment clears destination before taking source storage
Rehash computes destinations before rewiring so a custom open PackedWord trait panic leaves the original graph intact

observables: exact bucket modulus, extent and packed-node count
ordered bucket, node Mask and Data triples
moved-from/default, remove-all, Clear and empty ReSize states
native_matrix.original_fixture_preservation: All 264 original declarations and all 84 existing supplemental integration tests run unchanged against canonical nodes.

allocation_scope.native: NATIVE Standard::AllocateOptimal/Free allocate bucket pointers; ordinary C++ global new/delete allocate nodes, without DEFINE_STANDARD_ALLOC on PackedMapNode
allocation_scope.rust: Private aligned std::alloc::alloc/dealloc bucket owner, separate from std::boxed::Box new/drop nodes; no BaseAllocator payload headers
differences: StandardMemory is alignment-1 Vec<u8> and cannot safely serve as typed pointer storage; this private aligned adapter implements the pinned native heap policy without routing through that byte API.
Rehash temporarily allocates destination indices before link mutation for unwind safety of Rust public unsealed integer traits; native integral-only rehash allocates only a replacement table.
Rust custom global allocators, C++ replaced new/delete, alternate OCCT memory-manager configurations and injected allocation failure traces are not claimed equivalent.

remaining_gaps: Full class/compiler/crosswalk reconciliation remains separate; scoped bindings carry zero new global API credit.
Exact allocation instrumentation/policy parity remains open for the documented private aligned adapter and rehash scratch allocation.
